analyst_note: All ten refuted findings fall into two buckets, neither material to the Validive oral mucositis Phase 2b/3 readout. Seven are minor-severity operational claims about interim analysis timing (Q1 2023 guidance) vs. the registered primary completion date (Feb 2024). While the registry shows completion slippage, interim analyses routinely occur well before primary completion, and these timing optimism patterns are common IR behavior, not efficacy masking. Three are minor cross-study comparisons for camsirubicin in ASTS—a completely different program and indication—so they do not bear on the catalyst trial per decision principle #2. No company-level dishonesty findings, no catalyst-trial efficacy manipulation detected. Clean entry into the print.
